bullets.text: Active Exploitation Alert - **Microsoft Defender** identifies ongoing attacks exploiting **SolarWinds Web Help Desk** vulnerabilities.
Windows 11 Insider Preview - New features in **Windows 11** Beta Channel include Emoji 16.0 and camera controls.
Windows Security Evolution - **Microsoft** introduces **User Transparency and Consent** to enhance app security in **Windows 11**.
Prompt Attack Findings - **Microsoft** reveals vulnerabilities in **LLMs** that can be exploited through simple prompts.
New AI Model Launch - **Claude Opus 4.6** now available in **Microsoft Foundry**, enhancing enterprise AI capabilities.
Clickfix Variant Detected - New **CrashFix** variant uses social engineering to deploy a **Python RAT**.
Operation Winter SHIELD - **Microsoft** supports a new initiative to close the security implementation gap.
Windows 11 Insider Updates - New builds released in **Dev** and **Canary Channels** with various improvements.
Detecting Backdoored Models - **Microsoft** releases research on identifying backdoors in language models.
AI Security Practices - **Microsoft** expands its **Secure Development Lifecycle** to address AI-specific risks.
